web_content_02ce1e74a8ca1a29.primary_content:
How to Build Internal Links

Internal linking helps search engines understand the relationship between pages.
A strong internal linking system connects relevant articles using meaningful anchor text.

Topic clusters improve site structure by grouping related pages around a central theme.
Semantic relevance helps ensure that links are useful for both readers and search engines.

A good internal link should match the user's intent, the article context, and the destination page.
